capability.summary: Convert one UTF-8 HTML file to an ATX-heading Markdown string returned inside JSON
capability.description: Reads an existing HTML file, calls python-markdownify with fixed `heading_style="ATX"`, and emits the converted Markdown under the `markdown` key. It does not write a Markdown file or fetch HTML from a URL.
capability.problem_space: In-memory Markdown rendering from one local HTML file using markdownify defaults plus ATX headings; not web fetching, HTML sanitization, DOM extraction, layout preservation, or persistent document conversion.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing UTF-8 HTML file path; output: JSON object containing the converted Markdown string under `markdown` or a structured missing-path error.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 text file containing HTML accepted by python-markdownify
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "markdownify", target: string, markdown: string}. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. File open, UTF-8 decoding, parser, or conversion exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback rather than JSON.
limitations: uses markdownify defaults with only heading_style fixed to ATX; callers cannot configure bullets, wrapping, stripping, conversion options, or custom converters
does not fetch URLs, execute browser rendering, process external resources, or preserve visual layout and CSS presentation
does not sanitize untrusted HTML or guarantee safe Markdown links/content and should not be treated as a security filter
reads and returns the entire document in memory without an explicit timeout, size limit, or output truncation and does not write a .md file

output_contract.description: JSON object containing the converted ATX-style Markdown string under `markdown`, along with tool and target metadata.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
